title: Selected Topics in Asian American Studies; Asian American Creative Writing
description: A creative writing workshop for storytellers who are interested in drafting personal narratives, short stories, essays, and lyrics on and off the page. During our time together, we will read and respond to works by Asian American writers and artists of color, we will reflect on their art and craft, and we will commit to our own writing processes- drafting, sharing, workshopping, revising.
